legend.jpSafety.accidentsPeriod: NPA 2025 main records = injury crashes counted in 2025 statistics (~97% occurred in 2025; ~3% occurred in 2024 or earlier and were counted in 2025), published 2026-10-01; {total} crashes, one point each
legend.jpSafety.accidentsScope: Injury crashes only (fatal = death within 24 h); property-damage-only crashes are not in this file and not covered. Locations are as recorded by police; 3 crashes without coordinates are not mapped.
legend.jpSafety.accidentsSource: Source: National Police Agency website (Traffic Accident Statistics Open Data), processed · Public Data License 1.0
